AUSTIN, Texas, Aug. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- inKind, the curated restaurant commerce platform helping great restaurants access capital, guests, and technology, today announced the closing of an oversubscribed $414 million second financing tranche led by Citi and Cross River alongside Sagard, Varadero Capital, and Trinity Capital. The transaction brings inKind's total capital raised to more than $1.2 billion.

results.title: Exclusive: InKind secures $414M led by Citi for restaurant financing - Fast Company
results.author: Kristen Hawley
highlights: Today, InKind announced $414 million in financing in a round led by Citi and Cross River. The latest funding comes just one month after InKind secured $320 million from Liberty Mutual Investments and six months after announcing a $450 million round of debt and equity funding led by Magnetar, an Illinois-based investment firm.
